function roll()
r_stage1_1=stage1[1][math.random(1,#stage1[1])]
r_stage2=stage2[math.random(1,#stage2)]
r_stage5=stage5[math.random(1,#stage5)]
r_stage6=stage6[math.random(1,#stage6)]
r_stage7=stage7[math.random(1,#stage7)]
local a=math.random(1,#stage8[2])
r_stage8_2=stage8[2][_G.k1]

s10=math.random(1,#stage10)
r_stage10=stage10[s10]

end roll()

local function status(txt)
  --  print("[Macro] " .. tostring(txt))

local function pausedTotalNow()
    local total = RM.PausedTotal or 0
    if RM.Paused and (RM.PauseStarted or 0) > 0 then
        total += os.clock() - RM.PauseStarted
    end
    return total
end

local function playElapsed(startTime, pauseBase)
    return os.clock() - startTime - (pausedTotalNow() - (pauseBase or 0))
end

local function freezeCharacterForPause()
    pcall(function()
        local _, hrp, hum = getChar()
        hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        hum.AutoRotate = false
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
end

function getChar()
    local char = plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    return char, hrp, hum
end

local function tableToV3(t)
    return Vector3.new(t and t[1] or 0, t and t[2] or 0, t and t[3] or 0)
end

local function tableToCF(t)
    return CFrame.new(unpack(t))
end

local function safeJsonDecode(raw)
    if not raw or raw == "" then
        return false, {}
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
    end)

    if ok and type(result) == "table" then
        return true, result
    end

    warn("JSONDecode lỗi:", result)
    return false, {}
end

local function rawFramePos(frame)
    if frame.pos then
        return Vector3.new(frame.pos[1] or 0, frame.pos[2] or 0, frame.pos[3] or 0)
    end

    if frame.cf then
        return Vector3.new(frame.cf[1] or 0, frame.cf[2] or 0, frame.cf[3] or 0)
    end

    return nil
end

local function rawFrameLook(frame)
    if frame.look then
        return Vector3.new(frame.look[1] or 0, frame.look[2] or 0, frame.look[3] or 0)
    end

    if frame.cf then
        local ok, cf = pcall(function()
            return CFrame.new(unpack(frame.cf))
        end)

        if ok and cf then
            return cf.LookVector
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function framesAreStill(anchor, cur, posEps, cosEps)
    local pa = rawFramePos(anchor)
    local pb = rawFramePos(cur)

    if not pa or not pb then
        return false
    end

    if (pa - pb).Magnitude > posEps then
        return false
    end

    local la = rawFrameLook(anchor)
    local lb = rawFrameLook(cur)

    if la and lb and la.Magnitude > 0.01 and lb.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        local dot = la.Unit:Dot(lb.Unit)
        if dot < cosEps then
            return false
        end
    end

    if anchor.jump or cur.jump then
        return false
    end

    if anchor.state ~= cur.state then
        return false
    end

    return true
end

-- Bỏ các frame đứng yên dư thừa (giữ frame đầu + frame cuối của mỗi đoạn đứng yên
-- để giữ đúng thời gian đứng), chỉ nén phần vị trí/hướng không đổi.
local function compactIdleFrames(frames)
    if not REMOVE_IDLE_FRAMES or not frames or #frames <= 2 then
        return frames
    end

    local cosEps = math.cos(math.rad(IDLE_ANGLE_EPSILON_DEG))
    local out = { frames[1] }
    local anchor = frames[1]
    local removed = 0

    local i = 2
    while i <= #frames do
        local cur = frames[i]
        local nextFrame = frames[i + 1]

        if framesAreStill(anchor, cur, IDLE_POS_EPSILON, cosEps) then
            if i == #frames then
                table.insert(out, cur)
            elseif not (nextFrame and framesAreStill(anchor, nextFrame, IDLE_POS_EPSILON, cosEps)) then
                table.insert(out, cur)
                anchor = cur
            else
                removed += 1
            end
        else
            table.insert(out, cur)
            anchor = cur
        end

        i += 1
    end

    if removed > 0 then
        status("Đã bỏ " .. tostring(removed) .. " frame đứng yên dư thừa (" .. tostring(#frames) .. " -> " .. tostring(#out) .. ")")
    end

    return out
end

-- Nội suy (lerp) một frame "ảo" tại đúng thời điểm targetT, dựa trên 2 frame
-- liền kề a (trước) và b (sau). Dùng khi biên cắt không trùng frame có sẵn,
-- để cắt đúng chính xác số giây yêu cầu thay vì snap vào frame gần nhất.
local function lerpFrameAtTime(a, b, targetT)
    if not a then return b end
    if not b then return a end

    local ta = a.t or 0
    local tb = b.t or ta
    local alpha = 0
    if tb > ta then
        alpha = math.clamp((targetT - ta) / (tb - ta), 0, 1)
    end

    local out = {}
    for k, v in pairs(a) do
        out[k] = v
    end

    if a.cf and b.cf then
        local okA, cfA = pcall(tableToCF, a.cf)
        local okB, cfB = pcall(tableToCF, b.cf)
        if okA and okB then
            local cfL = cfA:Lerp(cfB, alpha)
            out.cf = { cfL:GetComponents() }
        end
    else
        local pa, pb = rawFramePos(a), rawFramePos(b)
        if pa and pb then
            local p = pa:Lerp(pb, alpha)
            out.pos = { p.X, p.Y, p.Z }
        end

        local la, lb = rawFrameLook(a), rawFrameLook(b)
        if la and lb and la.Magnitude > 0.01 and lb.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            local l = la.Unit:Lerp(lb.Unit, alpha).Unit
            out.look = { l.X, l.Y, l.Z }
        end
    end

    out.t = targetT
    -- Biên cắt là điểm "đang giữa chuyển động" nên không tính là nhảy/idle riêng
    out.jump = false

    return out
end

local function trimFramesByTime(frames, trimStart, trimEnd)
    if not frames or #frames == 0 then
        return frames
    end

    if (trimStart or 0) <= 0 and (trimEnd or 0) <= 0 then
        return frames
    end

    local minT = frames[1].t or 0
    local maxT = frames[#frames].t or minT
    local lo = minT + (trimStart or 0)
    local hi = maxT - (trimEnd or 0)

    if hi <= lo then
        status("Cắt đầu/cuối quá dài, vượt hết độ dài macro -> bỏ qua cắt")
        return frames
    end

    local out = {}
    local prevBeforeLo, firstAfterLo = nil, nil

    for i, f in ipairs(frames) do
        local t = f.t or 0

        if t < lo then
            prevBeforeLo = f
        elseif t >= lo and t <= hi then
            if #out == 0 and not firstAfterLo then
                firstAfterLo = f
            end
            table.insert(out, f)
        end
    end

    -- Chèn điểm bắt đầu chính xác tại "lo" nếu frame đầu tiên giữ lại không
    -- khớp đúng thời điểm (tránh cắt hụt/dư so với giây yêu cầu).
    if #out > 0 and (out[1].t or 0) > lo and prevBeforeLo then
        table.insert(out, 1, lerpFrameAtTime(prevBeforeLo, out[1], lo))
    end

    -- Chèn điểm kết thúc chính xác tại "hi" nếu frame cuối giữ lại không
    -- khớp đúng thời điểm.
    if #out > 0 and (out[#out].t or 0) < hi then
        -- tìm frame liền sau hi để nội suy
        for _, f in ipairs(frames) do
            local t = f.t or 0
            if t > hi then
                table.insert(out, lerpFrameAtTime(out[#out], f, hi))
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if #out < 2 then
        status("Cắt đầu/cuối làm mất hết frame -> bỏ qua cắt")
        return frames
    end

    return out
end

local function trimActionsByTime(actions, minT, maxT, trimStart, trimEnd)
    if not actions or #actions == 0 then
        return actions
    end

    if (trimStart or 0) <= 0 and (trimEnd or 0) <= 0 then
        return actions
    end

    local lo = minT + (trimStart or 0)
    local hi = maxT - (trimEnd or 0)

    if hi <= lo then
        return actions
    end

    local out = {}
    for _,a in ipairs(actions) do
        local t = a.t or 0
        if t >= lo and t <= hi then
            table.insert(out, a)
        end
    end

    return out
end

local function setLoadedData(data, trimStart, trimEnd)
    local frames = data.frames or data.route or {}
    local anims = data.anims or {}
    local emotes = data.emotes or {}

    trimStart = trimStart or 0
    trimEnd = trimEnd or 0

    if (trimStart > 0 or trimEnd > 0) and #frames > 0 then
        local minT = frames[1].t or 0
        local maxT = frames[#frames].t or minT

        local trimmed = trimFramesByTime(frames, trimStart, trimEnd)
        if trimmed ~= frames then
            frames = trimmed
            anims = trimActionsByTime(anims, minT, maxT, trimStart, trimEnd)
            emotes = trimActionsByTime(emotes, minT, maxT, trimStart, trimEnd)
            status("Đã cắt " .. tostring(trimStart) .. "s đầu / " .. tostring(trimEnd) .. "s cuối")
        end
    end

    RM.Frames = compactIdleFrames(frames)
    RM.Anims = anims
    RM.Emotes = emotes
end

local function stopAllTracks()
    for _,track in ipairs(RM.ActiveTracks or {}) do
        pcall(function()
            track:Stop(0)
            track:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    RM.ActiveTracks = {}
    RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds = {}
end

local function setTracksPaused(paused)
    RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds = RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds or {}

    for _,track in ipairs(RM.ActiveTracks or {}) do
        pcall(function()
            if paused then
                if RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds[track] == nil then
                    local speed = 1
                    pcall(function()
                        speed = track.Speed
                    end)
                    RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds[track] = speed
                end

                track:AdjustSpeed(0)
            else
                local speed = RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds[track] or 1
                track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
            end
        end)
    end

    if not paused then
        RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds = {}
    end
end

local function setPaused(state)
    if state then
        if not RM.Playing or RM.Paused then
            return
        end

        RM.Paused = true
        RM.PauseStarted = os.clock()
        setTracksPaused(true)
        freezeCharacterForPause()
        status("Paused")
    else
        if not RM.Paused then
            return
        end

        RM.PausedTotal = (RM.PausedTotal or 0) + math.max(0, os.clock() - (RM.PauseStarted or os.clock()))
        RM.Paused = false
        RM.PauseStarted = 0
        setTracksPaused(false)
        status("Resumed")
    end
end

local function restoreMoveAnimations()
    for _,obj in ipairs(RM.DisabledAnimateObjects or {}) do
        pcall(function()
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                obj.Enabled = true
            end
        end)
    end

    RM.DisabledAnimateObjects = {}
end

local function replayAnim(animData)
    if not animData or not animData.id then
        return
    end

    local _, _, hum = getChar()
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator")

    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    anim.AnimationId = animData.id

    local ok, track = pcall(function()
        return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
    end)

    if ok and track then
        table.insert(RM.ActiveTracks, track)

        pcall(function()
            track:Play(0)
        end)

        if animData.speed then
            pcall(function()
                track:AdjustSpeed(animData.speed)
            end)
        end

        RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds = RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds or {}
        RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds[track] = animData.speed or 1
        if RM.Paused then
            pcall(function()
                track:AdjustSpeed(0)
            end)
        end

        if animData.timepos then
            pcall(function()
                track.TimePosition = animData.timepos
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function replayEmote(emoteData)
    if not emoteData then
        return
    end

    local _, _, hum = getChar()
    local success = false

    local function addReplayTrack(track, speed)
        if not track then
            return
        end

        table.insert(RM.ActiveTracks, track)
        RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds = RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds or {}
        RM.ActiveTrackSpeeds[track] = speed or 1

        if RM.Paused then
            pcall(function()
                track:AdjustSpeed(0)
            end)
        end
    end

    if emoteData.name and emoteData.name ~= "" then
        local okTrack, track = pcall(function()
            return hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrack(emoteData.name)
        end)

        if okTrack and track then
            success = true
            addReplayTrack(track, 1)
        end

        if not success then
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                return hum:PlayEmote(emoteData.name)
            end)

            success = ok and result ~= false
        end
    end

    if not success and emoteData.id then
        local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator")
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = emoteData.id

        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        end)

        if ok and track then
            addReplayTrack(track, 1)
            pcall(function()
                track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
            end)
            pcall(function()
                track:Play(0)
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function setCameraRotationFromFrame(frame)
    if not RECORD_CAMERA_ROTATION or not frame then
        return
    end

    RM.CurrentCamRel = nil
    RM.CurrentCamTarget = nil

    if frame.camRel then
        local ok, cf = pcall(function()
            return tableToCF(frame.camRel)
        end)

        if ok and cf then
            RM.CurrentCamRel = cf
            return
        end
    end

    if frame.camCf then
        local ok, cf = pcall(function()
            return tableToCF(frame.camCf)
        end)

        if ok and cf then
            RM.CurrentCamCF = cf
            RM.CurrentCamLook = cf.LookVector
            RM.CurrentCamUp = cf.UpVector
            return
        end
    end

    if frame.camLook then
        RM.CurrentCamLook = tableToV3(frame.camLook)
    end

    if frame.camUp then
        RM.CurrentCamUp = tableToV3(frame.camUp)
    end

    RM.CurrentCamCF = nil
end

local function startCameraRotationReplay()
    if not RECORD_CAMERA_ROTATION or RM.CameraReplayBound then
        return
    end

    RM.CameraReplayBound = true

    pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            RM.CamBlendFrom = cam.CFrame
            RM.CamBlendT0 = os.clock()

            local okChar, _, hrp = pcall(getChar)
            if okChar and hrp then
                RM.CamRealDistance = (cam.CFrame.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            end

            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(CAM_BIND_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
            if not RM.Playing then
                return
            end

            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then
                return
            end

            if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            end

            local target = nil

            if RM.CurrentCamRel then
                local okChar, _, hrp = pcall(getChar)
                if okChar and hrp then
                    target = hrp.CFrame * RM.CurrentCamRel
                end
            end

            if not target then
                target = RM.CurrentCamTarget
            end

            if not target then
                target = RM.CurrentCamCF
            end

            if not target then
                local look = RM.CurrentCamLook
                if not look or look.Magnitude < 0.05 then
                    return
                end

                local up = RM.CurrentCamUp
                if not up or up.Magnitude < 0.05 then
                    up = Vector3.yAxis
                end

                local pos = cam.CFrame.Position
                target = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + look.Unit, up.Unit)
            end

            if RM.CamBlendFrom and RM.CamBlendT0 then
                local alpha = math.clamp((os.clock() - RM.CamBlendT0) / CAM_BLEND_DURATION, 0, 1)
                local eased = 1 - (1 - alpha) ^ 3
                target = RM.CamBlendFrom:Lerp(target, eased)

                if alpha >= 1 then
                    RM.CamBlendFrom = nil
                    RM.CamBlendT0 = nil
                end
            end

            cam.CFrame = target
        end)
    end)
end

local function lockZoomAndRestoreCustom()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local okChar, _, hrp = pcall(getChar)

    if not cam or not okChar or not hrp then
        pcall(function()
            local _, _, hum = getChar()
            if cam then
                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                cam.CameraSubject = hum
            end
        end)
        return
    end

    local keepDist
    pcall(function()
        keepDist = (cam.CFrame.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
    end)

    if not keepDist or keepDist < 0.5 then
        keepDist = RM.CamRealDistance
    end

    local oldMin, oldMax

    pcall(function()
        oldMin = plr.CameraMinZoomDistance
        oldMax = plr.CameraMaxZoomDistance
    end)

    if keepDist and keepDist >= 0.5 then
        pcall(function()
            plr.CameraMinZoomDistance = keepDist
            plr.CameraMaxZoomDistance = keepDist
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        local _, _, hum = getChar()
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        cam.CameraSubject = hum
    end)

    for _ = 1, 3 do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end

    pcall(function()
        if oldMin then
            plr.CameraMinZoomDistance = oldMin
        end
        if oldMax then
            plr.CameraMaxZoomDistance = oldMax
        end
    end)
end

local function stopCameraRotationReplay()
    local wasBound = RM.CameraReplayBound

    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CAM_BIND_NAME)
    end)

    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(APPROACH_BIND_NAME)
    end)

    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(APPROACH_CAM_BIND_NAME)
    end)

    RM.CameraReplayBound = false
    RM.CamBlendFrom = nil
    RM.CamBlendT0 = nil
    RM.DisabledAnimateObjects = {}
    RM.MoveAnimCleaner = false

    if wasBound then
        lockZoomAndRestoreCustom()
    else
        pcall(function()
            local _, _, hum = getChar()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                cam.CameraSubject = hum
            end
        end)
    end

    RM.CamRealDistance = nil
    RM.CurrentCamCF = nil
    RM.CurrentCamRel = nil
    RM.CurrentCamTarget = nil
    RM.CurrentCamLook = nil
    RM.CurrentCamUp = nil
end

local function restoreCharacterControl()
    pcall(function()
        local _, hrp, hum = getChar()
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.Sit = false
        hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        end
    end)
end

local function fireTimedActions(startTime, actions, replayFunc, fromT, pauseBase)
    fromT = fromT or 0
    pauseBase = pauseBase or pausedTotalNow()

    for _,item in ipairs(actions or {}) do
        local itemT = item.t or 0

        if itemT + 0.05 >= fromT then
            task.spawn(function()
                local target = math.max(0, (itemT - fromT) / PLAY_SPEED)

                while RM.Playing and playElapsed(startTime, pauseBase) < target do
                    if RM.Paused then
                        freezeCharacterForPause()
                    end

                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end

                while RM.Playing and RM.Paused do
                    freezeCharacterForPause()
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end

                if RM.Playing then
                    replayFunc(item)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function frameToCF(frame, fallbackPos, fallbackFace)
    if frame and frame.cf then
        local ok, cf = pcall(function()
            return tableToCF(frame.cf)
        end)

        if ok and cf then
            return cf
        end
    end

    local pos = frame and tableToV3(frame.pos) or fallbackPos or Vector3.zero
    local face = frame and tableToV3(frame.look) or fallbackFace or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    face = Vector3.new(face.X, 0, face.Z)

    if face.Magnitude < 0.05 then
        face = fallbackFace or Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    end

    return CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + face.Unit)
end

local function setRootCFrameOnly(cf, vel)
    local _, hrp = getChar()
    hrp.CFrame = cf

    if vel then
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = vel
    end
end

local function frameToCamRel(frame, rootCF)
    if not RECORD_CAMERA_ROTATION or not frame or not rootCF then
        return nil
    end

    if frame.camRel then
        local ok, cf = pcall(function()
            return tableToCF(frame.camRel)
        end)

        if ok and cf then
            return cf
        end
    end

    if frame.camCf then
        local ok, camCF = pcall(function()
            return tableToCF(frame.camCf)
        end)

        if ok and camCF then
            return rootCF:ToObjectSpace(camCF)
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function applyCameraForRootCF(rootCF, frameA, frameB, alpha)
    if not RECORD_CAMERA_ROTATION or not rootCF then
        return
    end

    -- LƯU Ý: hàm này chạy theo Heartbeat (trong vòng lặp phát chính), nên KHÔNG được
    -- set cam.CFrame trực tiếp ở đây nữa. Việc set cam.CFrame thật sự đã được
    -- startCameraRotationReplay() đảm nhiệm qua RunService:BindToRenderStep (chạy theo
    -- RenderStepped, khớp tốc độ render). Nếu cả 2 nơi cùng set CFrame mỗi frame ở 2 tốc
    -- độ khác nhau (Heartbeat vs RenderStepped) thì camera sẽ bị giật/lag do đá nhau.
    -- Ở đây chỉ tính toán và LƯU state cho RenderStepped bind đọc lại.

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then
        return
    end

    local relA = frameToCamRel(frameA, frameA and frameToCF(frameA) or rootCF)
    local relB = frameB and frameToCamRel(frameB, frameToCF(frameB)) or nil
    local rel = relA

    if relA and relB then
        rel = relA:Lerp(relB, math.clamp(alpha or 0, 0, 1))
    elseif relB then
        rel = relB
    end

    if rel then
        local target = rootCF * rel
        RM.CurrentCamRel = rel
        RM.CurrentCamTarget = target
        RM.CurrentCamCF = target
    else
        setCameraRotationFromFrame(frameA or frameB)
    end
end

local function applyStateNoMove(hum, frame)
    if not frame then return end

    if frame.jump or frame.state == "Jumping" then
        pcall(function()
            hum.Jump = true
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end)
    elseif frame.state == "Climbing" then
        pcall(function()
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
        end)
    elseif frame.state == "Freefall" then
        pcall(function()
            hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
        end)
    end
end

-- Kích hoạt animation đi/chạy đúng hướng trong lúc phát (dựa theo vận tốc giữa 2 frame).
-- CHỈ dùng trong vòng lặp phát chính (playLoadedOnce), KHÔNG dùng trong approachToStartFrame
-- vì đoạn "đi tới điểm nối tiếp" đã tự bind hum:Move riêng của nó rồi.
local MOVE_ANIM_EPSILON = 0.05 -- studs/giây theo phương ngang, dưới ngưỡng này coi như đứng yên
local function applyMoveForVelocity(hum, vel)
    if not hum or not vel then
        return
    end

    local flat = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)

    pcall(function()
        if flat.Magnitude > MOVE_ANIM_EPSILON then
            hum:Move(flat.Unit, false)
        else
            hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        end
    end)
end

local function approachToStartFrame(frame, nextFrame)
    if not SMOOTH_APPROACH_TO_START or not frame then
        return true
    end

    local _, hrp, hum = getChar()
    if hum.Health <= 0 then
        RM.Playing = false
        return false
    end

    local targetCF = frameToCF(frame)
    local targetPos = targetCF.Position
    local function flatDistance(a, b)
        return (Vector3.new(b.X, a.Y, b.Z) - a).Magnitude
    end

    local dist = flatDistance(hrp.Position, targetPos)
    if dist <= APPROACH_START_STOP_DISTANCE then
        return true
    end

    status("Moving to start: " .. tostring(math.floor(dist)) .. " studs")

    pcall(function()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        end
    end)

    local oldAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
    local oldPlatformStand = hum.PlatformStand

    pcall(function()
        hum.AutoRotate = true
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.Sit = false
    end)

    local started = os.clock()
    local lastMoveTo = 0
    local lastProgress = os.clock()
    local lastDist = dist
    local approachAlive = true
    local currentDir = Vector3.zero

    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(APPROACH_BIND_NAME)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(APPROACH_CAM_BIND_NAME)
    end)

    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(APPROACH_BIND_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 50, function()
            if not approachAlive or not RM.Playing or RM.Paused then
                return
            end

            local okChar, _, bindHrp, bindHum = pcall(getChar)
            if not okChar or not bindHrp or not bindHum or bindHum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end

            local cur = bindHrp.Position
            local flatTarget = Vector3.new(targetPos.X, cur.Y, targetPos.Z)
            local delta = flatTarget - cur
            local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)

            if flat.Magnitude > 0.05 then
                currentDir = flat.Unit
                bindHum.AutoRotate = true
                bindHum.PlatformStand = false
                bindHum.Sit = false
                bindHum:Move(currentDir, false)

                pcall(function()
                    bindHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end)
            else
                currentDir = Vector3.zero
            end
        end)
    end)

    pcall(function()
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(APPROACH_CAM_BIND_NAME, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, function()
            if not approachAlive or not RM.Playing or RM.Paused then
                return
            end

            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local okChar, _, bindHrp = pcall(getChar)
            if not cam or not okChar or not bindHrp or currentDir.Magnitude < 0.05 then
                return
            end

            if cam.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            end

            local camPos = cam.CFrame.Position
            local lookAt = bindHrp.Position + currentDir * 25 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
            cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(camPos, lookAt), APPROACH_CAM_FOLLOW_LERP)
        end)
    end)

    local okMoveTo = pcall(function()
        hum:MoveTo(targetPos)
    end)
    if okMoveTo then
        lastMoveTo = os.clock()
    end

    while RM.Playing do
        local _, newHrp, newHum = getChar()
        hrp = newHrp
        hum = newHum

        if hum.Health <= 0 then
            RM.Playing = false
            approachAlive = false
            return false
        end

        if RM.Paused then
            freezeCharacterForPause()
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            continue
        end

        local now = os.clock()
        local curDist = flatDistance(hrp.Position, targetPos)

        if curDist <= APPROACH_START_STOP_DISTANCE then
            break
        end

        if now - started > APPROACH_START_MAX_TIME then
            status("Move start timeout")
            RM.Playing = false
            approachAlive = false
            return false
        end

        if curDist < lastDist - 0.25 then
            lastDist = curDist
            lastProgress = now
        elseif now - lastProgress > 3 then
            status("Không đi tới được điểm nối tiếp")
            RM.Playing = false
            approachAlive = false
            return false
        end

        if now - lastMoveTo > 0.85 then
            pcall(function()
                hum:MoveTo(targetPos)
            end)
            lastMoveTo = now
        end

        if targetPos.Y - hrp.Position.Y > 2.5 and curDist < 7 then
            pcall(function()
                hum.Jump = true
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            end)
        end

        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
    end

    approachAlive = false
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(APPROACH_BIND_NAME)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(APPROACH_CAM_BIND_NAME)
    end)

    if RM.Playing then
        pcall(function()
            hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            hum.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
            hum.PlatformStand = oldPlatformStand
        end)
        return true
    end

    return false
end

local function framePosition(frame)
    if not frame then
        return nil
    end

    if frame.pos then
        return tableToV3(frame.pos)
    end

    if frame.cf then
        local ok, cf = pcall(function()
            return tableToCF(frame.cf)
        end)

        if ok and cf then
            return cf.Position
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function findNearestFrameIndex(frames)
    if not START_FROM_NEAREST_FRAME or not frames or #frames <= 1 then
        return 1
    end

    local ok, _, hrp = pcall(getChar)
    if not ok or not hrp then
        return 1
    end

    local cur = hrp.Position
    local firstPos = framePosition(frames[1])

    if firstPos and (cur - firstPos).Magnitude <= NEAREST_START_DISTANCE then
        return 1
    end

    -- Nếu có tiến trình từ lần chạy trước (cùng danh sách frame, tức cùng macro),
    -- chỉ tìm điểm gần nhất TỪ ĐÓ TRỞ ĐI (cho lùi lại một chút để chỉnh),
    -- để tránh bị "kéo ngược" về một điểm ở đoạn đã đi qua chỉ vì nó gần hơn
    -- theo khoảng cách thẳng (ví dụ đường xoắn ốc / zíc zắc leo cao).
    local searchFrom = 1
    if RM.LastFrameIndex and RM.LastFrameCount == #frames then
        searchFrom = math.clamp(RM.LastFrameIndex - NEAREST_START_BACKWARD_TOLERANCE, 1, #frames)
    end

    local bestIndex = nil
    local bestDist = math.huge

    for i = searchFrom, #frames do
        local pos = framePosition(frames[i])
        if pos then
            local dist = (cur - pos).Magnitude
            if dist < bestDist then
                bestDist = dist
                bestIndex = i
            end
        end
    end

    -- Không tìm thấy gì hợp lệ trong phạm vi "phía trước" (hiếm khi xảy ra) -> quét lại toàn bộ như cũ
    if not bestIndex then
        for i, frame in ipairs(frames) do
            local pos = framePosition(frame)
            if pos then
                local dist = (cur - pos).Magnitude
                if dist < bestDist then
                    bestDist = dist
                    bestIndex = i
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return bestIndex or 1
end

local function playLoadedOnce(useNearestStart)
    if not RM.Frames or #RM.Frames == 0 then
        return
    end

    local _, _, hum = getChar()
    if hum.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    stopAllTracks()
    stopCameraRotationReplay()
    restoreMoveAnimations()

    local oldAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
    local oldPlatformStand = hum.PlatformStand

    local frames = RM.Frames
    local count = #frames
    local startIndex = 1

    if useNearestStart ~= false then
        startIndex = findNearestFrameIndex(frames)
    end

    startIndex = math.clamp(startIndex, 1, count)
    local baseT = frames[startIndex] and (frames[startIndex].t or 0) or 0

    RM.LastFrameCount = count
    RM.LastFrameIndex = startIndex

    if startIndex > 1 then
        status("Nearest frame: " .. tostring(startIndex) .. "/" .. tostring(count))
    end

    local arrived = approachToStartFrame(frames[startIndex], frames[startIndex + 1])
    if not arrived or not RM.Playing then
        hum.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
        hum.PlatformStand = oldPlatformStand
        restoreCharacterControl()
        return
    end

    local _, _, humAfterApproach = getChar()
    humAfterApproach.AutoRotate = false
    humAfterApproach.PlatformStand = false

    if RECORD_CAMERA_ROTATION and frames and frames[startIndex] then
        setCameraRotationFromFrame(frames[startIndex])
        startCameraRotationReplay()
    end

    local start = os.clock()
    local pauseBase = pausedTotalNow()
    fireTimedActions(start, RM.Emotes, replayEmote, baseT, pauseBase)
    fireTimedActions(start, RM.Anims, replayAnim, baseT, pauseBase)

    local function hardStopAt(rootCF)
        -- Giữ chết nhân vật đúng vị trí/hướng của frame cuối trong vài tick vật lý
        -- để triệt tiêu đà (velocity dư) trước khi trả control, tránh chạy lố qua đích.
        local _, hardHrp, hardHum = getChar()
        pcall(function()
            hardHum.AutoRotate = false
        end)

        for _ = 1, 6 do
            pcall(function()
                hardHrp.CFrame = rootCF
                hardHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hardHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hardHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            end)
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
    end

    local okRun, err = pcall(function()
        if count == 1 or startIndex >= count then
            local frame = frames[startIndex] or frames[count]
            local rootCF = frameToCF(frame)
            setRootCFrameOnly(rootCF, Vector3.zero)
            applyCameraForRootCF(rootCF, frame, nil, 0)
            hardStopAt(rootCF)
            RM.LastFrameIndex = count
        else
            for i = startIndex, count - 1 do
                if not RM.Playing then
                    break
                end

                local _, _, h = getChar()
                if h.Health <= 0 then
                    RM.Playing = false
                    break
                end

                local a = frames[i]
                local b = frames[i + 1]

                RM.LastFrameIndex = i

                local rawT1 = a.t or baseT
                local rawT2 = b.t or (rawT1 + (1 / 40))
                local t1 = math.max(0, (rawT1 - baseT) / PLAY_SPEED)
                local t2 = math.max(t1 + (1 / 120), (rawT2 - baseT) / PLAY_SPEED)

                while RM.Playing and playElapsed(start, pauseBase) < t1 do
                    if RM.Paused then
                        freezeCharacterForPause()
                    end

                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end

                local duration = math.max(t2 - t1, 1 / 120)
                local cfA = frameToCF(a)
                local cfB = frameToCF(b)
                local posA = cfA.Position
                local posB = cfB.Position
                local vel = (posB - posA) / duration

                repeat
                    if not RM.Playing then
                        break
                    end

                    local _, _, h2 = getChar()
                    if h2.Health <= 0 then
                        RM.Playing = false
                        break
                    end

                    if RM.Paused then
                        freezeCharacterForPause()
                        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                        continue
                    end

                    local now = playElapsed(start, pauseBase)
                    local alpha = math.clamp((now - t1) / duration, 0, 1)

                    local rootCF = cfA:Lerp(cfB, alpha)
                    setRootCFrameOnly(rootCF, vel)
                    applyCameraForRootCF(rootCF, a, b, alpha)
                    applyStateNoMove(h2, alpha < 0.5 and a or b)
                    applyMoveForVelocity(h2, vel)

                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                until playElapsed(start, pauseBase) >= t2
            end

            local last = frames[count]
            if RM.Playing and last then
                local rootCF = frameToCF(last)
                setRootCFrameOnly(rootCF, Vector3.zero)
                applyCameraForRootCF(rootCF, last, nil, 0)
                hardStopAt(rootCF)
                RM.LastFrameIndex = count
            end
        end
    end)

    if not okRun then
        warn("Play lỗi:", err)
    end

    local _, _, hum2 = getChar()
    hum2.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
    hum2.PlatformStand = oldPlatformStand
    restoreCharacterControl()
    restoreMoveAnimations()
    stopCameraRotationReplay()
end

-- ================================================================
-- HAI HÀM DUY NHẤT CẦN DÙNG
-- ================================================================

function stop()
    RM.Playing = false
    RM.Paused = false
    RM.PauseStarted = 0
    RM.PausedTotal = 0

    stopAllTracks()
    stopCameraRotationReplay()
    restoreCharacterControl()

    status("Stopped")
end

-- play(configText, trimStart, trimEnd, useNearest)
-- useNearest: true/false, mặc định true (giữ nguyên hành vi cũ nếu không truyền).
--   true  -> tìm frame gần vị trí hiện tại nhất để bắt đầu phát (như cũ)
--   false -> luôn phát từ frame đầu tiên, không tìm điểm gần nhất
function play(configText, trimStart, trimEnd, useNearest)
    if RM.Playing then
        status("Đang Play rồi")
        return
    end

    if useNearest == nil then
        useNearest = true
    end

    local ok, data = safeJsonDecode(configText)
    if not ok then
        status("Config JSON lỗi")
        return
    end

    setLoadedData(data, trimStart or 0, trimEnd or 0)

    if not RM.Frames or #RM.Frames == 0 then
        status("Config không có frame nào")
        return
    end

    RM.Playing = true
    RM.Paused = false
    RM.PauseStarted = 0
    RM.PausedTotal = 0
    status("Playing... (nearest start: " .. tostring(useNearest) .. ")")

    task.spawn(function()
        local _, _, hum = getChar()

        if hum.Health > 0 then
            playLoadedOnce(useNearest)
        end

        RM.Playing = false
        RM.Paused = false
        RM.PauseStarted = 0
        RM.PausedTotal = 0
        stopAllTracks()
        restoreMoveAnimations()
        stopCameraRotationReplay()
        restoreCharacterControl()
        status("Play done")
    end)
end

function isplaying()
    return RM.Playing == true
end

_G.play = play
_G.stop = stop
_G.isplaying = isplaying

status("Play/Stop macro loaded. Dùng: play([[ config json ]]) / stop()")


function distance(x)
if type(x) == "vector" then
return (x - game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude 
else
return (x.Position - game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude 
end end

function jump()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then
        return
    end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        hum.Jump = true
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end)
end

_G.jump = jump

-- ================================================================
-- ANTI-AFK
-- Dùng khi server tự kick người chơi vì không thao tác gì lâu.
-- Bắt sự kiện plr.Idled (Roblox tự bắn ra sau ~vài phút không bấm phím/chuột/không
-- di chuyển góc nhìn) rồi giả lập 1 thao tác vô hại qua VirtualUser để reset bộ đếm idle.
-- ================================================================

local function setAntiAFK(state)
    if state then
        if RM.AntiAFKConn then
            status("Anti-AFK đã bật rồi")
            return
        end

        local ok, VirtualUser = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("VirtualUser")
        end)

        if not ok or not VirtualUser then
            status("Không lấy được VirtualUser, không bật được Anti-AFK")
            return
        end

        RM.AntiAFKConn = plr.Idled:Connect(function()
            pcall(function()
                VirtualUser:CaptureController()
                VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
            end)
            status("Anti-AFK: đã gửi thao tác giả để tránh bị kick")
        end)

        status("Anti-AFK: ON")
    else
        if RM.AntiAFKConn then
            pcall(function()
                RM.AntiAFKConn:Disconnect()
            end)
            RM.AntiAFKConn = nil
        end

        status("Anti-AFK: OFF")
    end
end

-- antiafk()       -> đảo trạng thái bật/tắt
-- antiafk(true)   -> bật
-- antiafk(false)  -> tắt
function antiafk(state)
    if state == nil then
        state = RM.AntiAFKConn == nil
    end

    setAntiAFK(state)
end

function isantiafk()
    return RM.AntiAFKConn ~= nil
end

_G.antiafk = antiafk
_G.isantiafk = isantiafk

status("Anti-AFK loaded. Dùng: antiafk() để bật/tắt, antiafk(true)/antiafk(false) để set rõ ràng.")

function color(x)
local a=game.Workspace['WORLD 2'].Stage10
local b=a['DoorWall'..x].Indicator:GetChildren()
    for i=1,#b do
        if b[i].Transparency == 0 then
            if b[i].Name=="GreenSquare" then
            return 1
            elseif b[i].Name=="RedTriangle" then
            return 2
            elseif b[i].Name=="YellowCircle" then
            return 3
        end
    end
end end

function color_change(x,x1)
local a=game.Workspace['WORLD 2'].Stage10
local b=a['DoorWall'..x].Indicator
b.GreenSquare.Transparency=1
b.RedTriangle.Transparency=1
b.YellowCircle.Transparency=1
if x1 == 1 then
b.GreenSquare.Transparency=0
elseif x1==2 then
b.RedTriangle.Transparency=0
elseif x1==3 then
b.YellowCircle.Transparency=0
end end
